_comment: Hand-curated literals lifted verbatim from the out-of-band generator
226-228, AG2GENE at lines 250-253). They are manual curation, not derived data:
no script produces them and nothing validates them against ChEMBL.
`rule refresh_drug_annotation` consumes them to decide which agents to query
ClinicalTrials.gov for and how to map hits back onto genes.
Consequence worth stating: glioma-trial coverage is bounded by this list. An
axis shows no trial if its agent is absent here, which is not the same as no

notes.probe_suffix: '(probe)' marks agents queried as controls for a gene NOT in the shortlist (GRIN2A); strip before mapping.
notes.multi_gene: '/' separates genes an agent maps to (e.g. natalizumab -> ITGA4 and ITGB1); split before mapping.
notes.trial_cell_format: glioma_trials cells read '<agent> (<n>: <first three NCT ids>)' — a truncated summary, not the full trial list.
